why: Neighbor cooperation items mix border/peace pacts with helping and maintaining adjacent pictures, so the boundary between settling space and helping another room's work is easy to blur.

why.T3-009: Concepts mark the Cow Chop logo as completed, pride in the community achievement, and final image celebration, matching celebrating the finished work rather than merely saving or crediting it.

why.T3-091: The material centers on making one template official and resolving two-template confusion, so it holds placers to one plan rather than merely sharing directions.

why.T3-063: A standing spoiler-tag rule is applied to a canvas proposal, matching canvas posts handled under the sub's existing rules.

why.T3-009: The concepts announce finishing and congratulate the community on the completed intact work.

why.T3-027: The concepts argue whether bots were used and whether bot-made work was legitimate, which is the fairness and authenticity argument about scripts.

why.T3-011: Many concepts send pixels to maintain or defend neighbours' logos, matching helping another room's work with nothing asked.
why.T3-149: Explicit requests and agreements for peace with greenlattice and Halo over overlap match truces and peace pacts.
why.T3-010: Concepts accept or negotiate edge overlap and space with neighbours, matching border and space settlement.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-011 carries the ongoing help to neighbours' pictures but not the explicit peace or truce pacts that stop mutual undoing.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0312333, C1354393, and C0490823 satisfy T3-149's peace asked for, offered, and agreed between rooms in contact.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-149 if forced to one; the peace and truce pacts would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: The helping and peace themes do not carry the concrete edge and overlap border terms with Funhaus and Halo.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1383056, C0872655, and C0978150 satisfy T3-010's border and overlap settlement with neighbours.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-010 if forced to one; the overlap and border agreements would be lost.

why.T3-018: Most concepts decode the Cow Chop logo detail (knife, cow, bull, colors, origin) rather than explain the whole event.

why.T3-010: The largest share is negotiating space and overlap: relocation, permission, compromise, minimal overlap, and further negotiation. Also present at floor: T3-084 asking other rooms for help, T3-153 meeting in Discord, T3-150 alliance and protection.

why.T3-063: A standing spoiler-tag rule is applied to a canvas proposal, matching canvas posts handled under the sub's existing rules.

why.T3-070: The concepts give coordinates, build direction, and a letter guideline, so directions for placers lead.
why.T3-002: Repeated calls for everyone to join, help, and 'calling all hands' satisfy calling members in to place.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070 carries the coordinates and build guides but not the repeated rallying calls that recruit hands.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0861709, C0110007, and C1063793 satisfy T3-002's calls for members to come and place.

why.T3-087: The concepts identify and correct who is attacking—Funhaus, the Void, Linux, or own vandals—matching tracing who changed the work amid rivalry talk.

why.T3-092: A single member creates and watches a tiny personal tribute and asks others to keep an eye on it.

why.T3-021: Most concepts are maintenance and repair of the bull, border, blade, and holes against trolls and stray pixels.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 carries the repair and maintenance but not the recognition that apparent damage was friendly anti-griefing or one's own mistaken fill.

why.T3-042: The concepts repeatedly choose defence and upkeep over expansion, warning that greed or new pieces could undo the existing mark.
